title: Career development in Tourism and Travel industry

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain basic terms related to the tourism and travel industry.
Identify career opportunities and develop personal career plans.
Recognize various types of tourism and travel services and their providers.
Understand the impact of IT on tourism and travel business operations.
Apply problem-based learning and case study methods to analyze and solve industry-related issues.
Demonstrate effective presentation and communication skills.
Show adaptability, integration, and creativity in work.
Understand health, moral, civic, and professional responsibilities.
